tasks.title: Close the seven bound BETA-004 falsifiers without extending route or Simulation claims
tasks.context_query: ARD-06 BETA-004 bound review seven falsifiers single-read scope snapshot actual WorkspaceStore FSA immutable imported bundle scoped IndexedDB isolation immutable empty envelopes independent disposal journal-only missing-evidence exact cold-reopen golden
acceptance: Apply the exact content-addressed BETA-004 FALSIFIED_UNTRUSTED_SEED on the exact clean base; preserve every already passing behavior unless one of the seven bound review falsifiers requires a change, and never treat the predecessor as accepted.

Capture lessonId, roomId and sessionId exactly once before validation and before constructing/opening any persistence factory; adversarial getters that change or throw on later access cannot alter the validated scope or cause I/O.

Establish workspace authority only from an actual connected WorkspaceStore FSA backend or a validated imported-bundle boundary that snapshots canonical entries and does not retain caller-owned mutable Map authority; structural mode labels and post-construction caller mutations cannot forge or change persistence identity or bytes.

The envelope validation boundary always returns a new frozen collection, including the zero-envelope case, and recursively clones/freezes accepted envelopes; mutating or appending through any adapter-retained input after load cannot change replay, evidenceByOccurrence, projection or canonical serialization.

Both reader disposers are invoked exactly once and settled independently after every factory/load outcome; a synchronous throw or asynchronous rejection from either disposer cannot suppress the other cleanup or escape/replace the loader's typed result.

A scoped IndexedDB continuity read performs no full event-store content scan and never reads or degrades the requested lesson/session because another scope contains legacy or malformed rows. Integrity attributable to the requested scope is determined through scoped/indexable evidence; unattributable legacy material remains explicit quarantine/recovery metadata rather than being assigned to an arbitrary scope or used as verified evidence.
Journal-only unresolved evidence participates in phase selection and deterministically produces missing-evidence plus its typed recovery action; it cannot project empty/reopen-lesson.

Cold reopen uses fresh production event-log and WorkspaceStore adapters, proves both second-load sources and byte reads were consulted, and compares the complete ContinuityProjectionV1 and complete evidence occurrences with fixed independent golden values. First-vs-second equality is supplemental, never the oracle.

Focused adversarial tests falsify all seven conditions without duplicating production logic or asserting implementation trivia; the full Studio test, typecheck and production build gates pass. No App, Room or ViewNav wiring and no ARD-07, reachability, merge or deployment claim is introduced.
forbidden_changes: No edit outside the five exact paths; ContinuityResumeCard.tsx remains byte-identical to the seed unless a type-level consequence of one of the seven repairs strictly requires adaptation.
No dependency/package manifest, App, Room, ViewNav, TeacherDashboardView, global journal path, unrelated route, cloud backend or telemetry change.

No full-store getAll/readAll content scan in the scoped path, no cross-session corruption propagation, no localStorage authority, no structural FSA spoof, no caller-owned mutable bundle authority and no shared process cache.

No return of adapter-owned arrays, no cleanup sequence where evaluating one disposer can prevent evaluating the other, no swallowed branch that skips cleanup, and no test-only duplicate of validation/projection logic.

No partial/self-referential golden, mocked persistence descriptor as proof, weakened assertion/gate, commit publication, push, PR, merge, deploy, main write or modification of the preserved BETA-004 worktree.
